# Dorte Damgaard

Dorte Damgaard is a senior physician (overlæge) holding a doctoral degree (ph.d.) who serves on the steering committee of AFDK, the Danish national quality database for atrial fibrillation, and works at [[aarhus-universitetshospital|Aarhus Universitetshospital]] [^src1]. She is named on page 83 of the AFDK annual report covering the period 1 July 2022 to 30 June 2023, within the chapters describing the database's data foundation, patient-population definitions, data-collection limitations, and the composition of the steering group [^src1].

The corpus provides only her name, title, and institutional affiliation — no further biographical or professional detail is available. Her listing places her among the clinical leadership overseeing AFDK's efforts to document atrial fibrillation incidence and patient demographics across Denmark's five regions [^src1].
